d:
A woman cooks.
Quinn is a former chef who has been paralyzed and can no longer work. As part of an experimental treatment with a company called NeuroShift, she can enter a virtual world where she can do what she loves again while her body is being treated.
In this virtual world, she is accompanied by company minder Anders, who monitors her virtual self for signs of progress or distress and begins to develop a friendship with his charge. As Quinn gets used to her virtual self and shows a greater reluctance to leave, she is torn between the illusion of escape and the painful beauty of real life.
